# Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Role`](gmeow-Role.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Role>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A function or position an agent plays in some context, such as a job title or organizational role. A [gufo:RoleMixin](../../external/terms.md#gufo-rolemixin) played within a [`gmeow:Membership`](gmeow-Membership.md), never a subclass of the agent who plays it ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9) — roles are values, not kinds of person).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name a function or position an agent plays in a context — a job title, board seat, or organizational role — and bind it to a [`gmeow:Membership`](gmeow-Membership.md) via [`gmeow:hasRole`](../properties/gmeow-hasRole.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing an agent by role (a CFO is not a subclass of [`Person`](gmeow-Person.md) — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid bundling the role with a specific organization; that seat is a [`gmeow:Post`](gmeow-Post.md).

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:Role`](gmeow-Role.md), attach it to the relator with [`gmeow:hasRole`](../properties/gmeow-hasRole.md) on a [`gmeow:Membership`](gmeow-Membership.md); when the role is tied to one organization as a holder-independent seat, model that as a [`gmeow:Post`](gmeow-Post.md) bundling this [`Role`](gmeow-Role.md) and a [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md).

### Examples

- ex:cfoRole a [`gmeow:Role`](gmeow-Role.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "CFO"@en.
